cores.textbox: When this defends, put a card with **combo** from your graveyard on the bottom of your deck.{br}**Blade Break**

faces.printed_rules_text: When this defends, put a card with **combo** from your graveyard on the bottom of your deck.{br}**Blade Break** _(When the combat chain closes, if this defended, destroy it.)_
